title: Ruby Amethyst
body:
# Ruby Amethyst

![Ruby Amethyst Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d25128d3bc1e935ee3f152f17ed6284a1f21b25.png)

## Features
- Change the Color of All Amethyst Blocks/Items
- Includes Custom Armor Design Colors

<details>
<summary>Support Me</summary>

If you enjoy this texture pack, the best way to help is by subscribing to my YouTube channel [NagaMods](https://www.youtube.com/@NagaMoDss), checking my Modrinth profile for more content, joining my Discord, and following my social media!

Your support keeps this project alive. Thank you for downloading.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Install</summary>

To install this resource pack, select your Minecraft version in the download menu, and copy the downloaded file into Minecraft's resourcepacks folder. Alternatively, if you are using the [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app), you can easily add this resource pack to an instance by selecting "Install with Modrinth App" in the download menu.

</details>
